risks.risk: Sensor or lens mount is damaged, dirty, or worn.

proof_requests: Photo of the model label to confirm the exact Canon DSLR model.
Video of the camera powering on and operating menus.
Photo showing any lens, battery, charger, and accessories included.
Close-up of the sensor and lens mount.
Screenshot or video showing the shutter count.
response.reason: The witness identifies a Canon DSLR body from the rear view, so it can be priced at its worst case; the seller's specification and performance claims are unverified and need proof to raise the value.
